title: LEARN_MAP maps the large Learn docsets to their public MicrosoftDocs repositories, so detect decides most Learn pages by git history
goal: census.py LEARN_MAP gains entries, each checked against the page's github_feedback_content_git_url, for the most common unmapped Learn path prefixes (intune 134, api 80, windows 75, azure 70 on 2026-10-10), and a detect --sitemaps run measured before and after on the same day shows the wall time fall, recorded in kb/_self/reports/fact-diff.md.

run:

sys.exit(0 if all(any(p.startswith(x) for p,_,_ in census.LEARN_MAP) for x in ('intune/','windows/')) else 1)
